title.narrative: Enhancing Connectivity in the Northern and Central Agricultural Production Areas of Senegal

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to enhance resilient road connectivity in selected agricultural areas of Senegal and to support road safety institutional capacity development in Senegal.

The development objective of the Enhancing Connectivity in the Northern and Central Agricultural Production Areas of Senegal Project for Senegal is to enhance safe and resilient road connectivity in selected agricultural areas of Senegal. The project comprises of four components. The first component, enhancement of safe and resilient transport connectivity in the selected areas aims to improve connectivity in high agricultural production areas in the north (Ferlo, Delta and Senegal River valley) and center (groundnut basin), to significantly reduce road transport costs and to improve road safety. The second component, support for access to economic opportunities and small community infrastructure will finance small community infrastructure and or income generating activities for the rural population living in the project's area of influence, especially those benefitting women and other groups in a situation of vulnerability. The third component, project management and institutional support to the transport sector consists of following sub-components: (i) project management and implementation support; and (ii) institutional support to the transport sector. The fourth component, contingent emergency response component (CERC) is designed to provide a swift response in the event of an eligible crisis or emergency, by enabling the government to request the World Bank to reallocate project funds to support emergency response and reconstruction.

condition.narrative: Annual Work Plans and Budget submitted as drafts to the Association for review and comments at Effective Date + 1 months and theneach year no later than September 1 (FA, Section I.E.,1 of Schedule 2 to the FA and PA, FA, Section I.B.2 of the Schedule 2 to thePA).
As agreed in ESCP the GRM will be operational no later than three months after effectiveness and maintained throughout theproject's implementation.
The Project Implementing Entity has contracted the services of an OHS consultant no later than Effective Date + 3 months (PA,Section I.A2.4(b) of the Schedule to the PA).
The Project Implementing Entity has contracted the services of an external auditor no later than Effective Date + 4 months (PA,Section I.A2.4(d) of the Schedule to the PA).

The Project Implementing Entity has updated its Manual of Operation of the Project and its Manual of Procedures, no later thanEffective Date + 1 month: (PA, Section I.A2.4(c) of the Schedule to the PA).

The Project Implementing Entity shall maintain its PIU throughout the implementation of the Project, including with the followingstaff to be recruited or assigned no later than Effective Date + 1 month: (a) project coordinator; (b) procurement specialist; (c)financial management specialist; (d) monitoring and evaluation specialist; (e) environmental specialist; (f) social specialist; (g)gender specialist; (h) accountant; (i) four road engineers; (j) civil engineer for infrastructure (PA, Section I.A2.4(a) of theSchedule to the PA).

The Recipient has established the Project Steering Committee with ToR, composition, and resources acceptable to the Association:Effective Date + 1 month (FA, Section I.A.2(a) of Schedule 2 to the FA).

The Recipient shall pay an amount of not less than EUR 1,794,000 as counterpart funds to finance implementation of the RAP inaccordance with the sequencing indicated in the Annual Work Plans and Budgets approved by the Association (FA, Section I.D ofSchedule 2 to the FA).
